Deep Depression Brings Heavy Rain and Flood Alerts Across Eastern India

The India Meteorological Department issued a red‑warning alert for the Odisha districts of Kalahandi, Nabarangpur, Koraput and Malkangiri as a deep depression moved across the Andhra‑Odisha coast. The system produced 28 cm of rain in Visakhapatnam, caused heavy rain in Kolkata and Bengal, and damaged 613 km of roads in Andhra Pradesh. It made landfall near Kalingapatnam, prompting states in the region to brace for flooding.
